correctness.rationale: For arbitrary base field, fixing rank u fixes the dimension of ker A. Relative position of ker A and im B is exhausted by intersection dimension v−t, and independent source and target basis changes exhaust the choices of surjection B and injection on Y/ker A. Conjugating by the unipotent off-diagonal S,T changes only C, by SB−AT. The entire kernel of C ↦ (ker B → X/im A) consists of such changes: first extend the im A-valued part on ker B, then factor the remainder through B. The restriction/quotient map is onto. By complementary extensions, the Levi stabilizer acts independently and fully on the two residual spaces, so w gives exactly one orbit per admissible tuple. Counting choices of the intersection, its projection and its lifts produces q^{t(b−u−v+t)}; multiplying the injection counts and constant C-fibre count verifies every cardinality factor. Projection of im N to Y has dimension v with kernel im A+C(ker B), so the rank and Jordan formulas follow, and the uniform quotient-map distribution proves conditional independence. The balanced summand is h[(2 times sum over ell from 0 to m of min(ell+1,h))−min(m+1,h)] for m=max(u,v) and h=n−m+1. Independent symbolic summation of its two polynomial pieces gave the claimed parity formulas. Independent image-cardinality enumeration, via python /workspace/branches/independent-reproductions/algebra_reproduction.py, verifies all 4096 triples for (q,a,b,c)=(2,2,2,2) and 6561 for (3,2,2,1). The finite checks are corroboration only; the classification proof uses the full parabolic, not just the unipotent radical or the incidence-algebra unit group. The bundled checker was inspected, not executed.

evidence: A parabolic orbit is an isomorphism class of a flag with a nilpotent map lowering that flag. Goodwin–Hille–Röhrle encode these over an algebraically closed field using Δ-filtered modules; their Lemma 2.2 and Appendix A describe correspondence and AR data.
In characteristic two N²=0 iff (1+N)²=1, but conjugating 1+N by the three-block unipotent group leaves A,B themselves fixed. This is not the full-parabolic action.

value.rationale: The first complete block-poset case with a nontrivial composite and a residual long block is natural. Counting each full-parabolic orbit, not merely its ambient Jordan label, gives usable exact sizes for all dimensions and field orders and an explicit field-independent balanced count. The positive-composite dimension factor and conditional distribution make this more than another marginal calculation or the already known square-zero slice.
